```{r}
#| include: false
library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
library(gt); library(ggrepel); library(scales)

# ---- Data ----
excel_path <- "../6_Data/1_SoccerMon_Clean.xlsx"
players <- read_excel(excel_path, sheet = "Players")
daily   <- read_excel(excel_path, sheet = "Daily") %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
  left_join(select(players, Player, Label), by = "Player")

num_cols <- c("DailyLoad", "WeeklyLoad", "ACWR", "Monotony",
              "Fatigue", "Fatigue_z", "Soreness_z", "SleepQuality_z", "Stress_z")
daily <- daily %>% mutate(across(any_of(num_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))))

# ---- Style ----
navy <- "#1F4E79"; light <- "#5FB3E6"; red <- "#C0392B"; orange <- "#E67E22"; grey <- "#5A6270"
status_cols <- c("Speak to first" = red, "Monitor" = orange, "OK" = navy)
theme_rep <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top", axis.title = element_text(colour = grey),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1F2A36"))

chip <- function(x) paste0("<span class='chip chip-", tolower(gsub(" ", "-", x)), "'>", x, "</span>")
gt_style <- function(g) {
  g %>% tab_options(table.width = pct(100), table.font.size = px(13),
                    column_labels.font.weight = "bold", column_labels.background.color = "#F4F6F8",
                    table.border.top.style = "hidden", table.border.bottom.style = "hidden",
                    data_row.padding = px(6))
}

# ---- The week ----
end_day   <- as.Date(params$week_end)
start_day <- end_day - 6
prev_end  <- end_day - 7
team_label <- if (params$team == "All") "All players" else params$team
pool <- if (params$team == "All") daily else filter(daily, Team == params$team)

# Wellness this week: reports and the 7-day index (average of four z-scores)
wk <- pool %>%
  filter(Date >= start_day, Date <= end_day) %>%
  group_by(Player) %>%
  summarise(Reports = sum(!is.na(Fatigue)),
            across(c(Fatigue_z, Soreness_z, SleepQuality_z, Stress_z), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(c(Fatigue_z, Soreness_z, SleepQuality_z, Stress_z), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA, .x))) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(Wellness7d = mean(c(Fatigue_z, Soreness_z, SleepQuality_z, Stress_z), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Wellness7d = ifelse(is.nan(Wellness7d), NA, Wellness7d)) %>%
  select(Player, Reports, Wellness7d)

prev <- pool %>% filter(Date == prev_end) %>% select(Player, PrevLoad = WeeklyLoad)

squad <- pool %>%
  filter(Date == end_day, WeeklyLoad > 0) %>%
  left_join(wk, by = "Player") %>%
  left_join(prev, by = "Player") %>%
  mutate(Reports = coalesce(Reports, 0L),
         Change  = ifelse(!is.na(PrevLoad) & PrevLoad > 0, WeeklyLoad / PrevLoad - 1, NA),
         f_high  = coalesce(ACWR > 1.5, FALSE),
         f_low   = coalesce(ACWR > 0 & ACWR < 0.8, FALSE),
         f_well  = coalesce(Wellness7d < -0.5, FALSE),
         f_mono  = coalesce(Monotony > 2, FALSE),
         f_none  = Reports == 0,
         Status  = case_when((f_high | f_low) & f_well ~ "Speak to first",
                             f_high | f_low | f_well | f_mono ~ "Monitor",
                             TRUE ~ "OK"))

reason_names <- c("ACWR above 1.5", "ACWR below 0.8", "Low wellness", "Monotony above 2", "No wellness reports")
squad$Reason <- apply(as.matrix(squad[, c("f_high", "f_low", "f_well", "f_mono", "f_none")]), 1,
                      function(r) { x <- reason_names[as.logical(r)]; if (length(x) == 0) "" else paste(x, collapse = " · ") })

# ---- Headline numbers ----
n_players  <- nrow(squad)
squad_load <- sum(squad$WeeklyLoad, na.rm = TRUE)
prev_total <- pool %>% filter(Date == prev_end, WeeklyLoad > 0) %>% summarise(s = sum(WeeklyLoad)) %>% pull(s)
load_chg   <- if (length(prev_total) == 1 && prev_total > 0) squad_load / prev_total - 1 else NA
avg_acwr   <- mean(squad$ACWR[squad$ACWR > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
n_speak    <- sum(squad$Status == "Speak to first")
n_monitor  <- sum(squad$Status == "Monitor")
week_comp  <- sum(squad$Reports) / (n_players * 7)
no_reports <- squad %>% filter(f_none) %>% arrange(Label) %>% pull(Label)

chg_text <- if (is.na(load_chg)) "no comparison available" else
  paste0(ifelse(load_chg >= 0, "up ", "down "), percent(abs(load_chg), accuracy = 1), " on last week")

review <- squad %>%
  filter(Status != "OK") %>%
  arrange(factor(Status, levels = c("Speak to first", "Monitor")), desc(ACWR))
n_top <- min(nrow(review), 9)
```

::: {.summary}
**This week:** squad load was `r chg_text`. **`r n_speak`** `r ifelse(n_speak == 1, "player has", "players have")` both a load and a wellness flag and should be spoken to first; **`r n_monitor`** more `r ifelse(n_monitor == 1, "needs", "need")` monitoring.
:::

::: {.panel}
## Players to review

[Sorted by priority. "Speak to first" means load outside the safe range *and* wellness more than 0.5 SD below the player's normal.]{.lead}

```{r}
if (nrow(review) == 0) {
  cat("No players flagged this week.")
} else {
  review %>%
    transmute(Player = Label, Team, `Weekly load` = WeeklyLoad, `vs last week` = Change,
              ACWR, `Wellness (7d)` = Wellness7d, Status, `Why flagged` = Reason) %>%
    gt() %>%
    fmt_number(columns = `Weekly load`, decimals = 0) %>%
    fmt_percent(columns = `vs last week`, decimals = 0, force_sign = TRUE) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(ACWR, `Wellness (7d)`), decimals = 2) %>%
    sub_missing(missing_text = "–") %>%
    data_color(columns = ACWR,
               fn = scales::col_bin(c("#FBE3C4", "#FFFFFF", "#F5C6C0"), domain = c(0, 100),
                                    bins = c(0, 0.8, 1.5, 100), na.color = "#FFFFFF")) %>%
    text_transform(locations = cells_body(columns = Status), fn = chip) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(color = grey, size = px(12)),
              locations = cells_body(columns = `Why flagged`)) %>%
    gt_style()
}
```
:::

:::: {.two-col}
::: {.panel}
## Load vs wellness

[Each dot is a player. Shaded areas are outside the safe range.]{.lead}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5.4
#| fig-height: 4.4
xr <- c(0, max(2, max(squad$ACWR, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.1))
yr <- range(squad$Wellness7d, na.rm = TRUE) + c(-0.25, 0.25)
ggplot(squad, aes(ACWR, Wellness7d, colour = Status)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1.5, xmax = xr[2], ymin = yr[1], ymax = yr[2], fill = red, alpha = 0.07) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = xr[1], xmax = 0.8, ymin = yr[1], ymax = yr[2], fill = orange, alpha = 0.07) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = xr[1], xmax = xr[2], ymin = yr[1], ymax = -0.5, fill = red, alpha = 0.07) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.8, 1.5), linetype = "dashed", colour = grey) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = grey) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  geom_text_repel(data = filter(squad, Status != "OK"), aes(label = Label),
                  size = 3, show.legend = FALSE, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = status_cols) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = xr, ylim = yr, expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "ACWR (this week vs last 4 weeks)", y = "Wellness vs normal (7-day)") +
  theme_rep
```
:::

::: {.panel}
## Squad load, last 8 weeks

[Total weekly load by team. This week is highlighted.]{.lead}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5.4
#| fig-height: 4.4
weeks8 <- pool %>%
  filter(Date > end_day - 56, Date <= end_day) %>%
  mutate(WeekEnd = end_day - 7 * floor(as.numeric(end_day - Date) / 7)) %>%
  group_by(WeekEnd, Team) %>%
  summarise(Load = sum(DailyLoad, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(This = WeekEnd == end_day)

ggplot(weeks8, aes(WeekEnd, Load, fill = Team, alpha = This)) +
  geom_col(width = 5.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Team A" = navy, "Team B" = light)) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.45), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%d %b", breaks = unique(weeks8$WeekEnd)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Week ending", y = "Squad load (AU)") +
  theme_rep
```
:::

## Last four weeks for flagged players

[Daily training load. The week under review is shaded.]{.lead}

```{r}
#| fig-height: !expr fig_h
if (n_top == 0) {
  cat("No players flagged this week.")
} else {
  pool %>%
    filter(Player %in% top$Player, Date > end_day - 28, Date <= end_day) %>%
    mutate(Label = factor(Label, levels = top$Label)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(Date, DailyLoad)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = start_day - 0.5, xmax = end_day + 0.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = light, alpha = 0.18) +
    geom_col(fill = navy, width = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ Label, ncol = 3) +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%d %b") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Daily load (AU)") +
    theme_rep
}
```

::: {.panel}
## Wellness reporting

[`r percent(week_comp, accuracy = 1)` of possible reports were completed this week. Players who sent none: **`r if (length(no_reports) == 0) "none, everyone reported" else paste(no_reports, collapse = ", ")`**.]{.lead}
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Full squad this week (click to expand)"}
```{r}
squad %>%
  arrange(desc(ACWR)) %>%
  transmute(Player = Label, Team, `Weekly load` = WeeklyLoad, ACWR, Monotony,
            `Wellness (7d)` = Wellness7d, Reports, Status) %>%
  gt() %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `Weekly load`, decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(ACWR, Monotony, `Wellness (7d)`), decimals = 2) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "–") %>%
  data_color(columns = ACWR,
             fn = scales::col_bin(c("#FBE3C4", "#FFFFFF", "#F5C6C0"), domain = c(0, 100),
                                  bins = c(0, 0.8, 1.5, 100), na.color = "#FFFFFF")) %>%
  text_transform(locations = cells_body(columns = Status), fn = chip) %>%
  gt_style()
```
:::

::: {.footer}
**How flags work:** ACWR = acute (7-day) ÷ chronic (28-day) load, with the safe range taken as 0.8–1.5. Wellness (7d) = average of fatigue, soreness, sleep quality and stress z-scores over the week, where 0 is the player's own normal. Monotony = mean ÷ SD of daily load over the week. Flags prompt a conversation; they are not a diagnosis.<br>
Data: SoccerMon (Midoglu et al., CC BY 4.0). Report generated `r format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y")` with R and Quarto by Will Page.
:::
